intro_html: Turns "we emailed everyone" into something you can show: announcements go to a chosen audience, appear as a counter at the top of Odoo instead of in an inbox, and record exactly who pressed Acknowledge — and who has not.

features.title: Approved Before It Goes Out
features.desc: Draft, then waiting for approval, then published — and a refusal needs a written reason. No step can be skipped, and the check sits in the code, not just in the screen.

features.title: Four Ways To Pick The Audience
features.desc: Everybody, named people, whole departments, or everyone holding a job position. One rule decides membership, and the counter, the record rule and the pending list all reuse it.

features.title: A Counter In The Top Bar
features.desc: Published notices show as a number beside the clock. Opening it lists what is waiting, most urgent first, and clicking one opens it — no polling, no background traffic.

features.title: Who Has Not Acknowledged
features.desc: Acknowledged, audience size, and the difference as a list of names. The page says plainly that acknowledging records a button press, not that anyone read anything.

features.title: Standing Date Reminders
features.desc: Save the question once — "which work permits expire in the next 30 days" — and see a live count. It runs as you, so it never shows records you may not read.

features.title: Categories And Priority
features.desc: Policy, Safety, Social, Benefits — a list you maintain, each with its own colour, plus a priority on every notice. Deleting a category never deletes a notice.

features.title: Leaves The Board By Itself
features.desc: A daily scheduled run expires notices whose end date has passed. They stay readable in HR's records and disappear from everyone else's.

features.title: Separate Per Company
features.desc: Every model carries a multi-company record rule, and an announcement's audience can only ever reach employees of its own company.

limitations: Acknowledged means pressed the button. It is not evidence that the person read or understood anything, and should not be used as one — the module's own screens say so too.
Departments do not cascade. A notice sent to a parent department does not reach its sub-departments; add each department explicitly.
Reminders answer date questions only. There is no way to add an amount, state or status condition to one.

Reminder time zones. For datetime fields the day boundaries are plain 00:00:00–23:59:59 without a per-user shift — the same convention Odoo's own date filters use — so records within a few hours of midnight can fall either side for users far from the server's time zone.
The counter does not live-update. It refreshes on page load and when the dropdown is opened; there is no bus or websocket subscription.

Non-admin paths are covered by automated tests but were not verified by hand, because the test environment has no least-privileged account. Confirm the employee-visibility, acknowledge and officer-cannot-publish paths on your own install with a real non-HR user.
